title: Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr to share a stage in Las Vegas
summary: The two surviving Beatles will join Joe Walsh at his VetsAid benefit concert in January. Tickets went on sale today.
body:
Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr are to perform together at a charity concert in Las Vegas early next year.

The two surviving members of the Beatles will join Joe Walsh of the Eagles at VetsAid, his annual benefit for military veterans, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena on Friday 29 January 2027. Tickets went on sale today.

Also on the bill

The Killers, The War on Drugs, St. Vincent and Lucius are also due to play. It is the tenth VetsAid concert, and all net proceeds go to veterans' charities.

McCartney and Starr last performed together in December 2024, when Starr joined McCartney on stage at the O2 Arena in London. Walsh and Starr are brothers-in-law.

Sources: Rolling Stone, JamBase, AXS TV.
